The background features a blue building and some greenery.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The driver's right hand appears to merge into the steering wheel rim without clear finger definition. The left hand is also indistinct, showing signs of melting/fusion with the wheel hub.
The window frames and glass reflections in the blue building behind the cart lack sharp geometric lines, appearing slightly warped and painterly.
The arm/shoulder area of the person in pink pants on the far left blends slightly into the background foliage and the cart's body panel.
